selection.edition: international CircleCI API v2 plus GraphQL-unstable and runner API
selection.ownership: CircleCI (Circle Internet Services) is a US company founded in 2011 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The reviewed edition is the public cloud API at circleci.com/api/v2, not CircleCI Server self-hosted and not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official CircleCI API v2 (Circle-Token header, GET /api/v2/me, GET /api/v2/project/{project-slug}, GET /api/v2/project/{project-slug}/pipeline, GET /api/v2/pipeline/{id}, GET /api/v2/pipeline/{id}/workflow), San Francisco operator identity, and dated incident search (CircleCI + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. January 2023 production incident exfiltrated customer environment variables, tokens, and encryption keys after malware stole a 2FA-backed SSO session from an engineer laptop; CircleCI published a 13 January 2023 incident report, rotated tokens, and asked customers to rotate secrets. No current unresolved CircleCI customer API-key compromise of circleci.com is asserted.

exception.adoption: Historical incidents for non-China companies may proceed when contained and remediated; current unresolved issues remain held.
exception.usefulness: CircleCI user, project, pipeline, workflow, job, context, insights, orb, and runner operations covering the Composio CIRCLECI toolkit.
exception.incident: On 4 January 2023 CircleCI disclosed a security incident. Malware on an engineer laptop stole a valid 2FA-backed SSO session on 16 December 2022. The actor accessed production systems and exfiltrated customer environment variables, tokens, and keys; encryption keys were extracted from a running process. Last unauthorized production activity was recorded 22 December 2022. Several customers later reported unauthorized third-party access using stolen secrets.
exception.remediation: CircleCI shut down the compromised employee access on 4 January 2023, restricted production access, rotated customer-associated tokens (project API, personal API, GitHub OAuth, Bitbucket), partnered with AWS to notify customers of potentially affected AWS keys, and published a 13 January 2023 incident report asking customers to rotate remaining secrets and review logs from 21 December 2022.
exception.residualRisk: Historical customer-secret exposure. Live authentication and current security posture are unverified.

research.searchCoverage: Official CircleCI API v2 authenticates with Circle-Token (also documents Bearer). Healthcheck is GET /api/v2/me (pinned validator). Cloud host is circleci.com; CircleCI Server self-hosted hosts are omitted. January 2023 production secret-exfiltration incident is historical and remediated under the 2026-09-13 waiver.

incidents.affectedProduct: CircleCI cloud production (customer environment variables, tokens, keys)
incidents.affectedData: Customer secrets stored in CircleCI, including environment variables, API tokens, and encryption keys extracted from a running process.
incidents.remediation: Employee access shutdown, production access restriction, customer token rotation, AWS customer notification, and a 13 January 2023 public incident report.
incidents.residualRisk: Historical customer-secret exposure. Live authentication unverified.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

insights.workflows.test_metrics.list.description: Get test metrics for a project's workflow.

projectSlug.description: Project slug in the form vcs-slug/org-name/repo-name.

contexts.query.title: Query Context
contexts.query.description: Retrieve a context by UUID using GraphQL.

body.query: query($id: ID!) { context(id: $id) { id name createdAt } }

namespaces.exists.title: Query Namespace Exists
namespaces.exists.description: Check whether a registry namespace exists.

body.query: query($name: String!) { registryNamespace(name: $name) { id } }

orbs.categories.query.title: Query Orb Category ID
orbs.categories.query.description: Fetch an orb category ID by name.

body.query: query($name: String!) { orbCategoryByName(name: $name) { id name } }

orbs.exists.title: Query Orb Exists
orbs.exists.description: Check whether an orb exists and whether it is private.

namespace.description: Optional namespace to verify alongside the orb.

body.query: query($name: String!, $namespace: String) { orb(name: $name) { id isPrivate } registryNamespace(name: $namespace) { id } }

orbs.id.get.title: Query Orb ID
orbs.id.get.description: Fetch an orb ID and optional namespace ID by name.

namespace.description: Optional namespace name used to also return the namespace ID.

body.query: query($name: String!, $namespace: String) { orb(name: $name) { id } registryNamespace(name: $namespace) { id } }

orbs.latest_version.get.title: Query Orb Latest Version
orbs.latest_version.get.description: Fetch the latest published version of an orb.

body.query: query($name: String!) { orb(name: $name) { versions(count: 1) { version } } }

orbs.source.get.title: Query Orb Source
orbs.source.get.description: Retrieve YAML source for a specific orb version.

body.query: query($orbVersionRef: String!) { orbVersion(orbVersionRef: $orbVersionRef) { id version source orb { id } } }

organizations.plan_metrics.query.title: Query Plan Metrics
organizations.plan_metrics.query.description: Query organization plan metrics for a date range.

body.query: query QueryPlanMetrics($orgId: ID!, $startDate: Date!, $endDate: Date!) { organization(id: $orgId) { id name plan { metrics(startDate: $startDate, endDate: $endDate) { creditsUsed computeCredits } } } }

contexts.env_vars.delete_graphql.title: Remove Context Environment Variable (GraphQL)
contexts.env_vars.delete_graphql.description: Delete a context environment variable by name using GraphQL.

body.query: mutation($contextId: UUID!, $variable: String!) { deleteContextEnvironmentVariable(input: {contextId: $contextId, variable: $variable}) { ok error { type } } }

namespaces.rename.title: Rename Namespace
namespaces.rename.description: Rename a CircleCI registry namespace by UUID.

body.query: mutation($namespaceId: UUID!, $newName: String!) { renameNamespace(namespaceId: $namespaceId, newName: $newName) { namespace { id } errors { message type } } }

contexts.env_vars.store_graphql.title: Store Environment Variable
contexts.env_vars.store_graphql.description: Add or update a context environment variable using GraphQL.

body.query: mutation($contextId: UUID!, $variable: String!, $value: String!) { createContextEnvironmentVariable(input: {contextId: $contextId, variable: $variable, value: $value}) { ok error { type } } }

orbs.config.validate.title: Validate Orb Config
orbs.config.validate.description: Validate CircleCI orb YAML using the orbConfig GraphQL query.

body.query: query($orbYaml: String!) { orbConfig(orbYaml: $orbYaml) { valid errors { message } sourceYaml outputYaml } }
